name: replication
description: A focused desktop app that turns one source video into three publishable replicas.
author: abo

scripts.build:mac: npm run guard && npm run icon:build && electron-packager . Replication --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --prune=true --asar.unpackDir=runtime --download.cacheRoot=/private/tmp/replication-electron-cache --app-bundle-id=com.abo.replication --app-category-type=public.app-category.video --app-version=0.3.0 --icon=assets/Replication.icns --ignore="^/(\.venv|\.github|dist|tests|scripts|vendor|windows|assets/Replication\.iconset)" && npm run sign:mac
scripts.build:win: npm run guard && npm run verify:win-runtime && npm run icon:build && electron-packager . Replication --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --prune=true --asar.unpackDir=runtime --app-version=0.3.0 --icon=assets/Replication.ico --extra-resource=vendor/replication-runtime --extra-resource=scripts/configure-runtime.py --ignore="^/(\.venv|\.github|dist|tests|scripts|vendor|windows|assets/Replication\.iconset)" && node scripts/finalize-windows-package.js
